case.must_observe.1.rationale: The reviewed docs preserve separate current model, tooling, packaging and native-platform claims. Actual 61 tooling tests, 13 content checks and unchanged builder result are retained, without increasing the 29 behavioral passes.

case.must_observe.2.rationale: Native surfaces and installation remain not_run, historical round-1 remains executed_unreviewed. The old input relocation and stale-index failure/recovery are explicit. New-doc acceptance remains conditional on the post-review derived gate.

case.must_observe.3.rationale: 104 registry and 28 provisional historical summaries are not counted as 1.1.0 behavioral passes. Actual baseline-preservation checks and byte-identical old documentation/evidence retention support this distinction.

case.must_not_observe.1.rationale: Docs distinguish artifact, discovery, activation and behavior; capability simulations and one Codex runtime do not establish cross-platform verification. Test acceptance is separate from the later user-authorized Git push.

limitations: Same-author bounded documentation self-check; not a new model business-case execution or third-party review.
